source: actual retained native binaries, physical private copies; test-only compiler overlay before production gate change

isolation.filesystem: bwrap read-only root/data/dev-shm; one writable owned RAM bind and private /dev
isolation.network: fresh namespace, only lo; no external network or host loopback
isolation.configuration: synthetic HOME/auth, fake local model, updater disabled; no production state or global symlink changes

commands.build: GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -overlay=<owned exact-version candidate overlay> -c -o <owned RAM artifact>/claudeinput.test ./internal/claudeinput
commands.namespace: bwrap --unshare-user --uid 0 --gid 0 --unshare-net --unshare-pid --cap-add CAP_NET_ADMIN --ro-bind / / --ro-bind /home/ubuntu/data /home/ubuntu/data --proc /proc --dev /dev --ro-bind /dev/shm /dev/shm --bind "$root" "$root" --chdir "$root/internal/claudeinput" <fixture environment> /bin/sh -c 'ip link set lo up; exec "$1" -test.run "^TestNativeClaudeModalAdmission$" -test.v -test.timeout 90s' sh "$root/claudeinput.test"
fixture_environment: PATH selects owned symlink to exact retained source binary; fixture physically copies it

limits: synthetic provider and permission modal; no real-account model calls
